meta.defaultDescription: Permanent solutions for humidity, insulation and space renovation across Attica. Free estimate, guaranteed quality.

hero.title: Your home, done right.
hero.subtitle: From the roof to the courtyard: insulation, painting, renovations and repairs for Attica's homes. One team for the whole job, with 18 years of experience.
hero.illustrationAlt: Drawing: a worker in a protective suit spraying insulation on a flat roof, Athens apartment blocks behind

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: From roofs to bathrooms: insulation, painting and renovation work across Attica.
services.partners: For electrical and plumbing work we team up with trusted electricians and plumbers, so you have one person for the whole job.

insulation.name: Insulation
insulation.title: Insulation & Waterproofing
insulation.cardDesc: Roofs, walls and basements: waterproofing membranes, spray polyurethane and external wall insulation.
insulation.subtitle: Permanent solutions against humidity, with high-durability materials and 18 years of experience.

sections.title: Roof Waterproofing
sections.text: We apply elastomeric bituminous membranes and cool-roof materials for complete roof waterproofing, ensuring long-term protection from leaks.

sections.title: Wall & Basement Insulation
sections.text: We treat rising damp with specialized renders and cementitious waterproofing coatings, stopping the problem at its root.

sections.title: External Wall Thermal Insulation
sections.text: External thermal insulation composite systems (ETICS) that reduce energy loss by up to 40% and upgrade the building's appearance.

sections.title: Bathroom & Wet Area Waterproofing
sections.text: Specialized waterproofing systems under tiles that prevent water penetration into adjacent spaces.

sections.title: Spray Polyurethane Foam
sections.text: Polyurethane foam sprayed onto flat roofs, tiled roofs, metal sheeting and ceilings, forming one seamless layer of insulation with no joints.

sections.title: Metal & Corrugated Roofs
sections.text: Gutter repairs, anti-rust protection and waterproof coatings for metal sheet and corrugated roofs.

whyItems: Free site inspection and detailed cost estimate
Certified materials from leading manufacturers
Written warranty on all work performed
Clean and organized way of working

painting.name: Painting
painting.title: Professional Painting
painting.cardDesc: Interior & exterior painting, facade renovation and decorative finishes.
painting.subtitle: Interior and exterior painting with excellent technical training and attention to detail.

sections.title: Interior Painting
sections.text: We use certified eco-friendly paints, with meticulous surface preparation (filling, priming) for a flawless finish.

sections.title: Exterior Painting & Facades
sections.text: Durable acrylic and silicone-based paints that protect the facade from weather conditions for years.

sections.title: Decorative Finishes
sections.text: Special decorative renders, textured finishes and cement-look finishes for a modern aesthetic.

sections.title: Anti-Rust Protection for Metal Surfaces
sections.text: Painting of railings, doors and metal structures with long-lasting anti-corrosion systems.

sections.title: Damp Walls & Ceiling Repair
sections.text: Scraping, re-plastering and filling where damp or fallen plaster has damaged walls and ceilings, before any paint goes on.

sections.title: Fire Damage Restoration
sections.text: Soot cleaning, stain-blocking primers and fresh paint to make a fire-damaged room livable again.

whyItems: Protection of furniture & floors during work
Completion within the agreed timeline
Quality materials from leading paint manufacturers
Site clean-up after completion

renovations.name: Renovations
renovations.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Renovations
renovations.cardDesc: Complete bathroom and kitchen renovations, from demolition and plumbing to tiles and fixtures.
renovations.subtitle: We rebuild bathrooms and kitchens from the bare walls up, with waterproofing at every step.

sections.title: Full Bathroom Renovation
sections.text: Removal of old tiles and fixtures, new plumbing pipework, and a finished bathroom handed back ready to use.

sections.title: Waterproofing Before Tiling
sections.text: A waterproofing layer under the shower and floor tiles, so water never reaches the rooms next door or below.

sections.title: Tiles & Fixtures
sections.text: Wall and floor tiling, concealed cisterns, shower enclosures, basins and bathroom furniture.

sections.title: Kitchen Renovation
sections.text: From planning the new layout to stripping out the old kitchen, pipework, tiling and painting the room.

whyItems: One person responsible for the whole job, with trusted electricians and plumbers for the wiring and pipework
Waterproofing in every bathroom, not just new tiles
The rest of your home protected from dust and debris
Debris removed and the space cleaned at the end

demolition.name: Demolition
demolition.title: Wall Demolition
demolition.cardDesc: Knocking down walls, stripping tiles and plaster, and taking the debris away.
demolition.subtitle: We open up spaces and strip out whatever has to go, leaving the room clean and ready for what comes next.

sections.title: Interior Wall Demolition
sections.text: We take down non-load-bearing walls to join spaces, such as a kitchen and living room, and tidy up the floor, walls and ceiling around the opening.

sections.title: Stripping Tiles & Plaster
sections.text: Old tiles, plaster and wall coverings removed back to the brick, as the first step of a renovation.

sections.title: Openings in Walls
sections.text: Creating or widening openings for doors, windows and passageways.

sections.title: Debris Removal
sections.text: The debris is bagged and taken away, so the space is left clean.

whyItems: Floors, furniture and window frames protected from dust and knocks
Load-bearing walls only with an engineer's approval
Debris removed and the space cleaned at the end
The space handed back ready for plastering, tiling or painting

paving.name: Paving
paving.title: Paving & Courtyards
paving.cardDesc: Stone paving, concrete walkways and balcony tiles for courtyards and outdoor spaces.
paving.subtitle: Stone, concrete and tiles for courtyards, walkways and balconies that stand up to the weather.

sections.title: Stone Paving & Grouting
sections.text: Laying and grouting stone slabs in courtyards, entrances and walkways, including shop and restaurant courtyards.

sections.title: Concrete Walkways & Pavements
sections.text: New reinforced concrete for pavements, paths and yard surfaces.

sections.title: Balcony & Veranda Tiles
sections.text: Replacing worn tiles with the right fall, so rainwater drains away instead of pooling.

sections.title: Refreshing Outdoor Spaces
sections.text: Repairs, cleaning and new grout joints that bring tired courtyards back to life.

whyItems: Correct falls so water runs off
Waterproofing under the tiles where it's needed
Materials suited to outdoor use
A tidy site during the work and after

wood.name: Woodwork
wood.title: Wooden Shutters, Doors & Pergolas
wood.cardDesc: Restoring, painting and varnishing wooden shutters, doors and pergolas.
wood.subtitle: We bring old wooden shutters, doors and pergolas back to life, so you don't have to replace them.

sections.title: Shutters & Wooden Windows
sections.text: Sanding, repairing and painting or varnishing old wooden shutters and windows.

sections.title: Wooden Doors
sections.text: Stripping old paint and applying a new finish to front doors and interior doors.

sections.title: Pergolas & Trellises
sections.text: Varnishing and maintaining wooden pergolas, trellises and other wooden structures on roofs and terraces.

sections.title: Protection from Damp & Sun
sections.text: Wood preservatives and exterior varnishes that protect the wood from the weather.

whyItems: Repair instead of replacement wherever possible
Proper surface preparation before every coat
Materials made for outdoor use
Surroundings protected while we work

repairs.name: Repairs
repairs.title: Small Repairs & Odd Jobs
repairs.cardDesc: Small repairs around the home: cracks, plaster, tiles, grout, silicone and anything else that needs a hand.
repairs.subtitle: The small jobs nobody wants to take on. We come round and finish them properly.

sections.title: Cracks & Plaster
sections.text: Closing cracks, patching fallen plaster and filling before painting.

sections.title: Tiles & Grout
sections.text: Replacing broken tiles, re-grouting and re-sealing with silicone in bathrooms and kitchens.

sections.title: Sealing
sections.text: Sealing around drains, pipes and window frames, wherever water gets in.

sections.title: Finishing After Other Trades
sections.text: After the plumber or electrician: closing wall chases, re-plastering and painting the spot.

whyItems: No job is too small
Several small jobs in one visit
A clear price before we start
Clean-up after the repair

process.title: No surprises, no hidden costs
process.subtitle: One clear path, from the first call to sweeping up when we're done.

steps.title: Call or message us
steps.text: Describe the problem — a photo helps, but it's not required.

steps.title: On-site inspection
steps.text: We come out, measure, and explain what's wrong and what it needs — no jargon.

steps.title: Written quote
steps.text: A fixed price before we start. What we agree on is what you pay.

steps.title: Work & clean-up
steps.text: We keep to the schedule and leave the space as clean as we found it.
